name: ghost-ink
description: Ghost Ink — an educational security exhibit on text concealment, deception, and the detection boundaries that catch each one. Static, offline-capable, no backend.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: node test/roundtrip.mjs && node test/container.mjs && node test/carriers.mjs && node test/build.mjs && node test/consistency.mjs
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && cap sync android && cap open android
